headline: Revenue rises modestly; net profit surges far ahead of it
summary_short: Yum! Brands' Q2 FY2026 revenue reached $2,169M (+5.3% q/q, +12.3% y/y), while diluted EPS jumped to $3.08 from $1.55 q/q and $1.33 y/y.
summary_long: Revenue was $2,169M, up 5.3% q/q and 12.3% y/y. Gross profit rose to $985M (+7.1% q/q, +8.8% y/y) while operating income grew more slowly to $655M (+1.7% q/q, +5.3% y/y) — gross margin held near flat but operating margin compressed slightly. Net income of $853M (+97.5% q/q, +128.1% y/y) far outpaced operating income growth, pointing to a large below-the-line item not decomposed here. Diluted EPS was $3.08, versus $1.55 q/q and $1.33 y/y. Cash fell to $674M (-2.2% q/q, -0.4% y/y). Current portion of long-term debt rose sharply to $2,823M from $1,751M q/q and $974M y/y. Shareholders' equity remained negative at -$7,107M, improving modestly from -$7,283M q/q and -$7,680M y/y.
